name: Elementor Pro
couldBuild: A drag-and-drop editor over a block tree. The concept is not the hard part.
stillMissing: Theme builder, popup builder, forms, WooCommerce widgets, hundreds of templates, and compatibility with every theme on earth. Scope alone sinks it.
requirements: Drag-and-drop canvas over a serialisable block tree with undo/redo
Responsive controls per breakpoint for every property
Theme builder: header, footer, single and archive templates with display conditions
A form widget with validation, actions-after-submit and entry storage
Global colours and fonts propagating across the whole site
